parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: A client token. It is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

parameters.name: Language
parameters.description:
The language of the error message. Valid values:

- **en**: English (Default)

- **cn**: Chinese

parameters.name: TaskId
parameters.description: The ID of the full backup or restore job.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dbs describe-job-error-code --task-id r1iv62ud0000 --biz-language en --client-token ETnLKlblzczshOTUbOCz0000 --api-version 2019-03-06 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dbs DescribeJobErrorCode --region cn-hangzhou --TaskId r1iv62ud0000 --Language en --ClientToken ETnLKlblzczshOTUbOCz0000
